sentences: UL consists of logarithmic-space computations with at most one accepting computation on each input.
The cited passage asks whether this unambiguous class is closed under complement.
Closure would mean that rejecting instances also admit an equally economical unambiguous decision procedure.
The paper encounters the issue while defining functions and composing algorithms for planar depth-first search.
The project addresses a structural complexity question whose answer affects how safely unambiguous subroutines can replace ordinary nondeterministic reachability tests.
